correctness.rationale: Exact entry criterion is derived from the classical 2x2 parity law. Integer Boolean finite differences remove all degree-two-or-higher Boolean coordinates; a pivot on the fresh-type unit and primitive column relations reduce the cokernel for \(k\ge3\) to independent order-two generators plus a cyclic factor of order \(2(k+1)\). Separate k=1,2 proofs are given. The standalone independently coded exact matrix generator checks five compressed Smith forms, eight full example Smith forms, and 4130 pair feasibility entries. No inference from finite checks to all k is made.

value.rationale: The integer cokernel of a natural all-base directed logical feasibility relation has a closed structural classification depending solely on old E-class count despite exponentially many complete types. It exposes an exact 2-primary torsion rank and the sharp odd-characteristic obstruction p dividing k+1. This is materially stronger than existing scalar type counts, nontrivial for every \(k\ge3\), and potentially useful in linearized logical orbit/constraint questions.
